popup.about.title: About E-Mart
popup.about.content: E-Mart is Pakistan's premier destination for groceries, household essentials, electronics, and more. Founded in 2024, we've been dedicated to providing quality products at competitive prices. Our mission is to make shopping accessible to everyone while providing exceptional customer service.
popup.careers.title: Careers at E-Mart
popup.careers.content: Join our dynamic team and help shape the future of e-commerce in Pakistan! Current Openings: Senior Web Developer, Customer Support Representative, Digital Marketing Specialist, Warehouse Manager. Send your CV to: careers@emart.pk
popup.returns.title: Returns & Refunds
popup.returns.content: Easy 14-Day Return Policy: Items must be unused and in original packaging. Free returns within 14 days of delivery. Refund processed within 5-7 business days.
popup.shipping.title: Shipping Information
popup.shipping.content: Delivery Options: Standard Shipping 3-5 business days (Free over PKR 2,000). Express Shipping 1-2 business days (PKR 500). Same Day Delivery available in Lahore (PKR 800).
popup.warranty.title: Warranty Policy
popup.warranty.content: All products come with manufacturer warranty. Warranty periods vary from 1-3 years depending on the product. Contact support@emart.pk for warranty claims.
popup.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
popup.faq.content: Q: How do I create an account? A: Click Login/Register and follow the steps. Q: Is my payment secure? A: Yes, we use 256-bit SSL encryption. Q: Can I track my order? A: Yes, go to My Orders after login.
popup.contact.title: Contact Us
popup.contact.content: Phone: +92 300 1234567 (9AM-6PM, Mon-Sat). Email: support@emart.pk. Office: 123 Main Street, Lahore, Pakistan.
popup.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
popup.privacy.content: Your privacy matters to us. We never sell your personal data to third parties. We collect only the information necessary to process your orders and improve our services.
popup.terms.title: Terms of Service
popup.terms.content: By using E-Mart, you agree to our terms and conditions. You must be 18+ to create an account. All prices are in PKR and inclusive of applicable taxes.
